payload.title: Style profile store + reference corpus
payload.description:
**Phase 1 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d` (quality-first editorial rewrite loop).

## Intent

As a publication operator, I want an editable style profile and a small approved reference corpus, so later editorial passes can match a real house voice instead of generic Internet prose.

## Done when

- An editable style profile (YAML or equivalent) can be stored for a publication/pod: voice name, audience, tone, sentence style, structure, prefer/avoid lexicon, evidence rules.
- 5–10 approved reference samples are linked or stored for voice match.
- Profile is loadable by later diagnostic/revision passes.
- No detector scores in the profile.

## Notes

Start narrow (one Anth.us voice). Expand toward 20–100 samples later. Do not replace Chattic.us-web `publication-writing` banned-phrase checks.

Migrated from PPY-1c06f1.
